query:
DELETE a FROM giving_monthly a
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT year, month, campus, subgroup, MAX(id) as max_id
  FROM giving_monthly
  GROUP BY year, month, campus, subgroup
) b ON a.year = b.year AND a.month = b.month AND a.campus = b.campus AND a.subgroup = b.subgroup
WHERE a.id < b.max_id;
